THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Open-Faced Steak and Cheese Sando

Ready-cooked steak bites over melted Velveeta on two slices of Inked Keto sourdough, finished with TARI Smoky Heat and Tropical Kick—both toasts together are one serving at ≈270 calories and 34g protein.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME5 min air-fryer Bake (plus toasting)
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~34g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Both open-faced toasts together count as 1 full lunch serving (270 calories, 34g protein, 29.7g total carbs with 20g fiber, 9.8g fat), including 1 tsp of each TARI sauce.

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 2 slices Inked Keto Big Bread Wolf Sourdough (54g total)
  • 1 whole pouch Fresh Additions fully cooked steak bites (91g)
  • 2 Velveeta Original slices (42g total)

Ingredients — continued

  • 1 tsp (5g) TARI Smoky Heat sauce
  • 1 tsp (approx. 5g) TARI Tropical Kick sauce
  • No added butter or oil

Allergens: wheat, gluten, dairy.

You want a hot steak-and-cheese lunch in minutes without searing raw steak or dirtying a skillet—using a single 91g pouch of ready-cooked steak bites across two open-faced keto sourdough toasts.

Method

  1. 1.TOAST & ADD CHEESE. Toast the 2 slices of Inked Keto Big Bread Wolf Sourdough, then place 1 Velveeta Original slice onto each toast.
  2. 2.DIVIDE READY-COOKED STEAK. Open the 91g pouch of Fresh Additions fully cooked steak bites and divide the steak evenly between the two cheese-topped toasts.
  3. 3.AIR-FRYER BAKE (~5 MIN). Place both open-faced toasts in the air-fryer basket. Suggested setting: Bake at 350°F / 175°C for about 5 minutes until the Velveeta melts and the precooked steak is warmed through (Bake mode and 5 minutes were confirmed on film; 350°F / 175°C is a suggested temperature).
  4. 4.FINISH WITH TWO TARI SAUCES. Drizzle one toast with 1 tsp TARI Smoky Heat and the second toast with 1 tsp TARI Tropical Kick. Serve both toasts together as one lunch.

Keys to success

  • No butter or oil is added to the bread or steak.
  • The filmed cook confirmed the air-fryer Bake mode and 5-minute time; 350°F / 175°C is a suggested temperature because the exact temperature was not recorded.

Storage and reheating

Store: Keep unopened Fresh Additions steak pouches, Velveeta slices, and TARI sauces refrigerated. Assemble and bake fresh in 5 minutes when ready to eat.

Reheat: Baked toasts are best eaten hot right out of the air fryer so the sourdough stays crisp.

Lasts: Best assembled and baked fresh.

Estimated nutrition

~34g protein per Both open-faced toasts together, including both 1 tsp sauces.

Label-based estimate for BOTH open-faced toasts together (including both sauces): 270 calories, 34g protein, 29.7g total carbohydrate (including 20g dietary fiber; ~9.7g net carbs), and 9.8g fat. Breakdown: 2 slices / 54g Inked Keto Big Bread Wolf Sourdough (60 cal, 8g protein, 22g total carbs, 20g fiber, 2g fat) + 1 whole pouch / 91g US Fresh Additions fully cooked steak bites (120 cal, 20g protein, 1g carbs, 0g fiber, 3g fat) + 2 slices / 42g Velveeta Original (80 cal, 6g protein, 6g carbs, 0g fiber, 4g fat) + 1 tsp / ~5g TARI Tropical Kick (10 cal, 0g protein, 0.7g carbs, 0.8g fat; 1/3 of 1 tbsp / 15g label serving) + 1 tsp / 5g TARI Smoky Heat (0 cal, 0g protein, 0g carbs, 0g fat per label). Uses Inked Keto sourdough, not ordinary sourdough; no added butter or oil.
